verdict.rationale: Milvus has a documented public programmatic API through the pymilvus `MilvusClient` SDK, with quickstart code for client creation and `client.search` calls. The docs state the same client API works across Lite, Standalone and Distributed deployments and covers CRUD, filtered, multi-vector and hybrid search. An llms.txt and an official MCP server add agent-friendly access. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed paths returned 404), and no independent hands-on corroboration of the API reference's depth.
